name: RA_LINE_ORDERING_RULES_
description: The RA_LINE_ORDERING_RULES table represents a line ordering rule in each row. A line ordering rule is a collection of columns that AutoInvoice uses to sort transaction lines when grouping transactions into invoices, debit memos, and credit memos. Each line ordering rule is assigned to one or more grouping rules. . The primary key for this table is ORDERING_RULE_ID.
